abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the Ovarian Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS, version 2022), the tumor marker carbohydrate antigen 125 (CA125), and ultra microangiography (UMA) in distinguishing benign from malignant adnexal masses. METHODS: A retrospective analysis of 320 patients with surgically confirmed adnexal masses was conducted. All patients underwent 2-dimensional ultrasound (transvaginal, transabdominal, or combined), UMA examination, O-RADS 22 classification (Categories 2-5), SUMA flow pixel ratio measurement, and preoperative tumor marker testing (CA125, CA19-9, HE4). Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and area under the curve (AUC) values were calculated for statistically significant variables. RESULTS: Two hundred and forty-nine (77.8%) were benign and 71 (22.2%) non-benign. Malignancy detection rates for O-RADS 22 categories 2-5 were 0.00, 6.88, 42.37, and 77.78%, respectively. Mature teratoma (22.2%) and serous cystadenoma (16.9%) were the most common benign lesions; high-grade serous adenocarcinoma (10.9%) and borderline serous tumor (5.3%) were the most common malignant lesions. Univariate analysis showed O-RADS 22 classification, SUMA flow pixel ratio, CA125, HE4, menopausal status, age, menopausal duration, and lymphocyte count were significantly associated with diagnosis (p < .05). Multivariate analysis identified O-RADS 22 classification, SUMA flow pixel ratio, CA125, and age as independent risk factors (p < .05). AUC values were 0.724, 0.794, 0.826, and 0.770, respectively; combined AUC was 0.906 (95% CI: 0.869-0.942), significantly superior to single parameters (p < .05, DeLong test). Combined application is particularly valuable when CA19-9 and/or HE4 are positive in mature teratomas or endometriotic cysts. CONCLUSION: Combined O-RADS, CA125, and UMA significantly enhance diagnostic accuracy for adnexal masses compared to individual modalities.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣付属器腫瘤の良性と悪性の鑑別において、卵巣付属器腫瘤の報告・データシステム（O-RADS, version 2022）、腫瘍マーカーであるCA125、および超微小血管造影（UMA）の診断性能を評価すること。方法：外科的に確定された付属器腫瘤320例の後方視的解析を実施した。全例で2次元超音波検査（経膣、経腹、または併用）、UMA検査、O-RADS 2022分類（カテゴリー2～5）、SUMAフロー画素比測定、および術前の腫瘍マーカー検査（CA125、CA19-9、HE4）を施行した。単変量および多変量ロジスティック回帰分析を行った。統計的に有意な変数についてROC曲線とAUC値を算出した。結果：249例（77.8%）は良性、71例（22.2%）は非良性であった。O-RADS 2022カテゴリー2～5の悪性検出率は、それぞれ0.00%、6.88%、42.37%、77.78%であった。最も多い良性病変は成熟奇形腫（22.2%）と漿液性嚢胞腺腫（16.9%）であった。最も多い悪性病変は高異型度漿液性腺癌（10.9%）と境界悪性漿液性腫瘍（5.3%）であった。単変量解析では、O-RADS 2022分類、SUMAフロー画素比、CA125、HE4、閉経状態、年齢、閉経期間、リンパ球数が診断と有意に関連した（p<0.05）。多変量解析では、O-RADS 2022分類、SUMAフロー画素比、CA125、年齢が独立したリスク因子として同定された（p<0.05）。AUC値はそれぞれ0.724、0.794、0.826、0.770であり、併用モデルのAUCは0.906（95%CI 0.869-0.942）で、単独指標より有意に優れていた（p<0.05、DeLong検定）。成熟奇形腫や子宮内膜症性嚢胞でCA19-9やHE4が陽性である場合に、併用が特に有用であった。結論：O-RADS、CA125、UMAの併用により、付属器腫瘤の診断精度は個別の検査法より有意に向上する。
